subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for plugin self-delivered outbound sends?
rationale: This PR promotes a new public Plugin SDK subpath, so automation cannot choose the final API name, idempotency semantics, or release contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept seam after proof
options.body: Require redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof and then land the generic report seam as the supported plugin self-delivery contract.

options.title: Hold for API redesign
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a narrower or differently named SDK surface before exposing this contract publicly.

options.title: Close branch, keep umbrella
options.body: Decline this public API direction and leave broader outbound hook parity to the existing canonical umbrella issue.

recommendation.title: Accept seam after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof and then land the generic report seam as the supported plugin self-delivery contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current history signal across the shared outbound files and adjacent merged hook-contract PRs.
